text.title: Lessons you can see
text.text: Every idea gets a clean diagram. Many are clickable or step through one stage at a time.
text.text2: Hands-on exercises as checklists that remember where you stopped.
text.text3: Quick questions inside lessons and a full quiz at the end of each chapter.
text.text4: Each chapter ends with the commands, files and flashcards worth memorising.
text.pageEyebrow: Free and open source · Ansible on RHEL
text.heroSub: A hands-on path from your first playbook to automating real Linux administration. Every idea is drawn as a diagram, every exercise runs on a practice lab you build yourself, and every chapter ends with a quiz and a cheat sheet.
text.heroFocus: It covers the Ansible skills that
text.heroFocus2: and system administration teams use every day, from a first playbook to roles, collections and Git.
text.label: Start with chapter 2
text.homeSectionSub: Each stage builds on the last. Your progress is saved in this browser.
